text: A prayer of Habakkuk the prophet, set to wild and enthusiastic music.
O LORD, I have heard the report about You and I fear. O LORD, revive Your work in the midst of the years, In the midst of the years make it known; In wrath [earnestly] remember compassion and love.
I [Habakkuk, in my vision] saw the tents of Cushan under distress; The tent curtains of the land of Midian were trembling.
You have trampled on the sea with Your horses, On the surge of many waters.
